approval_ref: Continue improving CIRP efficiency, accuracy and adaptability across RFI, Submittal and Email content.
notes: Reuse the complete terminal-run workflow index to bound one exact RFI or Submittal's primary sources.
Accept only explicit Cost Impact, Potential Cost Impact, Schedule Impact or Potential Schedule Impact labels in the correct workflow scope.
Normalize Potential labels only within the matching cost or schedule role and never estimate or calculate an impact.
Apply the same identity, role and complete-value contract to ordinary answers and comparison source findings.
Fail closed on missing fields, conflicts, cross-scope borrowing, Email-prefixed labels, headers, quoted history, signatures, ordinary prose, vision narration and oversized source sets.
title: Answer and ground exact workflow impact fields
objective: Return bounded exact workflow impact fields without provider cost and reject unsupported identity, role, value or source-scope borrowing in every answer scope.
